title: Model profile, or the estate's set of them (DEC-0046)
description: A named, ordered list of catalogue model ids with a fallback policy (Fabric ADR-0147). The estate's profiles are Fabric's registry/model-profiles.json, a `model-profiles` document; an agent may declare a profile of its own.

reads.description: The closed vocabulary of what a lane reads (DEC-0083): `user-content`, what a member, a client or the public sends; `operator`, only what the estate's own operator or its agents write; `web`, pages fetched from the open web. Only `user-content` carries a model rule (FAC-SEM-112), also beside another value; `operator` and `web` let a lane declare that it does not read user content. A new value takes a decision; a reader refuses an unknown one.

models.description: Catalogue ids, first choice first. On a key route this list is the key's model allow-list.

fallback.description: none: only the first model the policy admits; between-turns: the next one after a failed turn, never within one.

reads.description: What the lane this profile serves reads (DEC-0083); absent: not declared, which stays valid. A profile listing `user-content` — what a member, a client or the public sends: messages, questions, images, reviews, screenshots, voice — has an open-vendor route (FAC-SEM-112), whatever else it lists, and its runner treats a content refusal or an empty answer as a failed turn. `operator` and `web` carry no model rule in this revision.

agent.description: The agent that declares this profile for itself; absent: the estate's.
